def saisir():
    n=int(input("Donner N:"))
    while not(n<=50):
        n=int(input("Donner N:"))
    return n


def verif(ch):
    test=True ; i=0
    while test==True and i<len(ch):
        test="A"<=ch[i].upper()<="Z" or ch[i]==" "
        i=i+1
    if (ch[0]==" ") or ch[len(ch)-1]==" " or ch.find("  ")!=-1:
        test=False
    return test 


def remplir(n):
    F=open("Phrase.txt","w")
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ch=input("Donner la phrase"+str(i))
        while verif(ch)==False:
            ch=input("Donner la phrase"+str(i))
        F.write(ch+"\n")
    F.close()
    return F 




def crypter(ch):
    ch=ch[0:len(ch)-1] #Pour Supprimer le \n
    res=""
    ch=ch+" "
    r=0
    while ch!="":
        p=ch.find(" ")
        mot=ch[:p]
        r=r+1
        #.......
        ch1=""
        for i in range (len(mot)):
           c=chr(ord(mot[i].upper())+r)
           if c>"Z":
               ch1=ch1+chr(ord(mot[i])+r-26)
           else:
               ch1=ch1+chr(ord(mot[i])+r)
        #.........
        ch=ch[p+1:]
        res=res+ch1+" "
    return res   

def resultat(F,n):
    F=open("Phrase.txt","r")
    F1=open("Ph_crypt.txt","w")
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ch=F.readline()
        F1.write(crypter(ch)+"\n")
    F.close()
    F1.close()
    
        







#Programme_Principal
n=saisir()
F=remplir(n)
resultat(F,n)
